subject: Coffee at CES? Video annotation efficiency
text:
Hi [NAME] - happy new year! I saw you're at CES so I wanted to reach out
for a coffee. We work with Milestone Systems, Rhombus Systems and Lumana -
naturally your work at [COMPANY] has been on our radar!

For context - we help video surveillance teams accelerate iteration cycles
with a unified platform for data curation and annotation. So teams can
train and evaluate models more effiicently with high quality,
representative video data at scale.

My team is on the ground from to Friday - do you have 20 mins for a quick
coffee tomorrow afternoon?

subject: [NAME] - ML Pipelines
text:
Hi [NAME],

I saw you recently launched [COMPANY] Signals, enabling teams to leverage your
internal machine learning models. How are you evolving your ML pipelines to
enable with this?

We often hear that multimodal annotation and workflow orchestration create
bottlenecks for teams.

Encord works with several leading IDV teams to streamline these processes -
helping identify failure modes faster and improve model performance.

Would you be open to learning more?

subject: [SENDER] - Model Accuracy
text:
Hi [NAME],

When speaking with fraud prevention leaders, we often hear that in-house
data management tools are limited primarily to annotation.

With Encord's advanced Data Curation, we help IDV teams improve model
accuracy by enabling better data collection and exploration through
embedding and cluster-based search.

I'd love to explore how we could help solve similar challenges at [COMPANY] -
would you be open to learning more?

subject: Virtual Coffee - ride safety
text:
Hi [NAME], happy new year!

We connected with Xiaojing & Riley from your vision team last year, seems
like vision-based ride safety is an area we could help. Given your role as
the head of data, I'd love to connect and explore how we can support [COMPANY]'s
[YEAR] priorities as you launch in new locations.

For context - we're familiar with the typical challenges for teams building
models from million miles of driving data. Safety-focused mobility teams,
e.g. Motive and Woven (Toyota) leverage Encord to identify long-tail
scenarios and automate annotation at scale.

Keen to learn how you're thinking about model accuracy for ride safety and
properly introduce ourselves. How's Friday morning for a 30 min virtual
coffee?

subject: 3D ML pipelines - top of mind according to your CV team
text:
Hi [NAME],

Happy new year! I've spoken with a few members of your team and understand
3D annotation is a current focus at BNSF.

I saw you're quoted on the Roboflow website, so thought it would be useful
to show how teams like Zipline, Zeitview, and Skydio are using Encord to
consolidate their 2D and 3D ML pipelines for drone inspection.

For context Encord is 2D and 3D ML DataOps platform that helps AI teams
consolidate data curation, annotation and model evaluation under one roof.

I'm free this Friday after 10am CT if that works, but happy to align on
another time.
